summary.text: Eli Crane is the Republican incumbent for Arizona's 2nd Congressional District, first elected in 2022. He served in the U.S. Navy from 2001 to 2014, including three deployments with SEAL Team 3, and co-founded the company Bottle Breacher, which he sold in 2022. He serves on the House Committees on Oversight and Government Reform and Homeland Security.

paragraphs.text: Born in Tucson, Arizona, in 1980 and raised in Yuma, according to Wikipedia. Graduated from Cibola High School in 1998.

Studied at Arizona Western College and the University of Arizona but did not graduate; his official biography says he left the University of Arizona during his senior year to enlist in the Navy a week after the September 11 attacks.
Served in the U.S. Navy from 2001 to 2014. According to his official biography, he took part in five wartime deployments, three of them with SEAL Team 3.

In 2012, he and his wife, Jen, co-founded Bottle Breacher, a veteran-owned business that makes bottle openers from shell casings. It grew to employ dozens, appeared on Shark Tank according to Wikipedia, and was sold in 2022.
Won the 2022 Republican primary for Arizona's 2nd District and then defeated incumbent Rep. Tom O'Halleran 53.9%-46.1% in the general election.
Re-elected in 2024, defeating Democrat Jonathan Nez 54.5%-45.5%, and advanced from the July 21, 2026 Republican primary unopposed.

Serves on the House Committee on Homeland Security (Border Security and Enforcement; Transportation and Maritime Security subcommittees) and the Committee on Oversight and Government Reform (Cybersecurity, Information Technology, and Government Innovation; Military and Foreign Affairs subcommittees). In 2023-2024 he also served on the Veterans' Affairs and Small Business committees.
Is a member of the House Freedom Caucus, Western Caucus, and Border Security Caucus, among others.
Lives in Arizona with his wife, Jen, and their two daughters, according to his official biography.
